page.title: MCP Tool Registry
page.description: Register MCP tool servers (Streamable HTTP), discover their tools, and govern every tool with risk levels and required permissions before agents can bind them.

table.deleteConfirm: Delete this MCP server and all of its tool bindings?

form.endpointPattern: Must start with http:// or https://
form.authEnvVarTooltip: Only the variable name is stored; the secret value is read from the server environment at connect time.
form.authStoredHint: Credentials are stored. Leave both fields blank to keep {envVar} unchanged.
form.authClearWarning: Saving now will remove this server's credentials; the next sync or tool call will fail until a new pair is configured.
form.authAbsentHint: No credentials configured. Enter both fields to add a header backed by an environment variable.

errors.saveFailed: Failed to save the MCP server.
errors.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the MCP server.
errors.authPairRequired: Auth header and auth env variable must be provided together.

toolDrawer.title: Tools / {name}
toolDrawer.discoveryHint: New tools arrive disabled with no permissions. Assign required permissions before enabling, then bind tools to agents on the agent page.
toolDrawer.unusableTitle: {count} of {total} tools are enabled but not registered
toolDrawer.unusableDetail: Enabled is only intent. A tool reaches the model once its capability is registered; until then any agent bound to it simply loses that tool.

activationHint.server_disabled: The parent MCP server is disabled, so governed runs cannot call this tool.
activationHint.invalid_capability_id: This tool name cannot form a governed capability id, so it is never exposed to the model.
activationHint.permissions_required: Assign at least one required permission before this tool can be enabled.
activationHint.unknown_permissions: A required permission no longer exists in the permission catalog; re-save the permissions to register this tool.
activationHint.registration_pending: Not loaded on this control-plane instance yet. It resolves on demand, so the next tool call registers it; a sync or restart also refreshes it.
activationHint.registered: Registered on this control-plane instance: a governed run served by it can call this tool.

actions.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage the MCP tool registry.
actions.conflict: That change conflicts with an existing MCP server or tool.
actions.notFound: The MCP server or tool no longer exists.
